formulas.K1_0: K = sigma0*sqrt(pi*L) (undrained elastic crack; K set by traction BC, independent of moduli); per unit loading in sqrt(pi*L): 1
formulas.K1_inf: K = sigma0*sqrt(pi*L) (drained elastic crack, p -> 0 everywhere); per unit loading in sqrt(pi*L): 1
formulas.V1_0: V = pi*(1-nu_u)*sigma0*L^2/G; in L^2/G per unit loading: pi*(1-nu_u)
formulas.V1_inf: V = pi*(1-nu)*sigma0*L^2/G; in L^2/G per unit loading: pi*(1-nu)
formulas.V1_short_coeff: V ~= V1_0 + A*sqrt(c*t/L^2)*sigma0*L^2/G with A = 4*(nu_u-nu)/((1-nu)*sqrt(pi)) (1-D oedometric drainage layer at the faces)
formulas.p_faces_0: p = (nu_u-nu)*sigma0/(alpha*(1-2*nu)) (from zeta=0 with sigma_kk=-sigma0 at faces); per unit loading: (nu_u-nu)/(alpha*(1-2*nu))
formulas.K2_0: 0 (no bulk pressure yet; effective face traction alpha*p_f cancelled by boundary-layer body force)
formulas.K2_inf: 0 (p -> p_f everywhere in 2-D at long time; uniform effective stress gives no crack-tip singularity)
formulas.V2_inf: 0 (uniform strain state u_y = e_yy*y leaves the crack faces unseparated)
